description:
On local SF1 OBT data in DuckDB, 17 converted TPC-DS OBT statements still return no rows after query parameters started coming from dsqgen: 1, 6, 8, 10, 15, 19, 30, 35, 44, 45, 54, 58, 69, 78, 81, 83, 91. The cause is how the converter rewrites the base TPC-DS query against the one big table, not the parameters. For example, Q1 joins `returned_date_sk` to the sold date, so no return row matches. Any run of these statements times a query that returns nothing, so their results are not comparable with TPC-DS.

The converter is `benchbox/core/tpcds_obt/query_conversion.py`, with per-query rewrites in `query_specs.yaml`. Parameter rendering is already correct, and the parameter tests in `tests/unit/core/tpcds_obt/test_tpcds_obt_queries.py` cover it.

Also check the statements that return exactly one row. Before the parameter fix, 10 statements did (16, 18, 27, 28, 36, 88, 90, 94, 95, 96), and they are likely aggregates over an empty set. Confirm which of them are still affected now that parameters are real.
